title: Giri Standardized 4-Slot Fixed-Length Screen Layout Schema (screen.json v1.2)
description: Clean 4-slot fixed-length screen layout schema for Velliangiri OS (1280x720): header (44px), summary (148px: title <= 64 chars, text <= 250 chars), media_cards (312px: 4 full-bleed overlaid cards), and footer_links (58px: fixed bottom-left Ask Giri, 2 contextual buttons <= 42 chars, and fixed bottom-right Settings). Borders appear strictly on selectable elements only.

screen_id.description: Unique identifier for the current screen response.

header.description: Slot 1 (Fixed 44px Top Bar, border: none): 49x40 3D mountain emblem + 'Giri —' + prompt_title on the left.

prompt_title.description: Strict fixed-length user prompt or page context title (max 56 chars, no ellipsis).

summary.description: Slot 2 (Fixed 148px Clean Editorial Summary Zone, border: none): Title (<= 64 chars) + Concise Summary Text (<= 250 chars, zero ellipsis) + Source Caption (<= 48 chars).

title.description: Standardized single-line page headline (max 64 chars, no ellipsis).

text.description: Concise 1-2 sentence summary of the page content, strictly <= 250 characters (no ellipsis).

media_cards.description: Slot 3 (Fixed 312px Row of 4 Full-Bleed Visual Cards with Overlaid Text): Primary interactive row (Left/Right arrows). Strict title <= 26 chars and subtitle <= 38 chars.

footer_links.description: Slot 4 (Fixed 58px Row of 4 Selectable Bottom Buttons): [0] Fixed bottom-left 'Ask Giri', [1..2] 2 contextual links (<= 42 chars, zero '...'), [3] Fixed bottom-right 'Settings'.

title.description: Strict short card title (max 26 chars, zero '...').

subtitle.description: Strict short card subtitle (max 38 chars, zero '...').

badge.description: Top-left thumbnail badge (max 10 chars: LIVE NEWS, WEATHER, VIDEOS, GAME, PAGE IMAGE, PAGE VIDEO, PHOTO, VIDEO, APP).

meta_pill.description: Top-right thumbnail pill (max 8 chars: BBC, LIVE, 720P, HD, 00:15, PLAY, 43°C).

label.description: Strict max 42-character selectable button title summarized by the LLM (no '...' truncation).

standardAction.description: Maps selection of a media card or bottom button to an OS capability or standardized detail view.

parameters.description: Standardized parameters. For open_image/play_video, includes fixed-length title (<= 64 chars), summary (<= 250 chars), and source_caption (<= 48 chars).
